lines.zh: 我踩着雪走，蹄子陷下去。
lines.en: I walk the snow and my hooves sink in.
My brown wool hangs down to my knees.

lines.zh: 我走起来像一团会动的毯子。
lines.en: I move like a walking blanket.
Frost hangs on the wool tips and shines.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢走向背风的山坡。
lines.en: We drift slowly toward the sheltered slope.
My tail is short and barely moves.
The snow is deep, and I sink with each step.
I squeeze between two spruce trees.
Last year's dead leaves hide in my wool.
Thick wool weighs my legs; I cannot go fast.
The herd forms a single line.
The snow swallows the sound of my hooves.
I stop to take a bite of snow.

lines.zh: 前面有片没被踩过的雪。
lines.en: There is untouched snow up ahead.

lines.zh: 我慢慢蹭过结冰的水沟。
lines.en: I ease past a frozen ditch.

lines.zh: 我走在牛群最后，蹄印最深。
lines.en: I walk last in the herd, my prints deepest.

lines.zh: 我站着打盹，毛上落了雪。
lines.en: I doze standing up while snow settles on my wool.
Warm. This coat of wool is warm.
I chew slowly and bring it back up again.
A bird has landed on my back.
I flick my ears, chasing off the flies.
Wind comes down off the slope.
I rub an itch against the wooden fence.

lines.zh: 这块石头被我的毛焐热了。
lines.en: My wool has warmed this stone.
I open my mouth and puff out a cloud.
I am doing nothing at all, just standing here.
It is snowing again, and I do not shelter.
I chew a while, then swallow it down.
A louse is crawling through my wool.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转了个身，换个方向。
lines.en: I turn around slowly to face another way.
Snow settles on my horns. I do not bother.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子埋进毛里，呼气暖。
lines.en: I tuck my nose into my wool and breathe warm.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剪刀，我认得。
lines.en: I recognise those shears in your hand.
You smell like dried hay to me.
Do not shear me yet; pet me first.
I lift my eyes to you, slowly.
Your hands are cold; put them in my wool.

lines.zh: 我偏过头，一只眼对着你。
lines.en: I turn my head until one eye faces you.

lines.zh: 你比我见过的牧羊人瘦。
lines.en: You are thinner than the shepherds I have known.
I am not afraid of people, only too lazy to move.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖快埋进我的毛里。
lines.en: Your knees are nearly buried in my wool.
My lashes hang over my eyes.
What are you laughing at? Is my wool messy?
I have had my eye on you for quite a while.
You have sheared off a big patch of my wool.
It stings, but I cannot be bothered to run.
Blood on brown wool is hard to see.
I let out one dull, muffled cry.
Stop hitting me; I did nothing to you.
I hide myself among the herd.
That blow left my knees without strength.

lines.zh: 我的毛被削得参差不齐。
lines.en: My wool is now cut unevenly all over.
I back up against the fence.
The pain will fade, but I will remember.
Wheat? I can smell it.

lines.zh: 把那把苜蓿递到我嘴边。
lines.en: Bring that clover right up to my mouth.
I lift my left hoof, then my right.
Do not go far; I am following.
Dried hay chews better than what is under snow.

lines.zh: 我鼻子顶了顶你的口袋。
lines.en: I nudge your pocket with my nose.

lines.zh: 为了小麦，我可以站起来。
lines.en: For wheat I could even stand up.
Give that handful a shake for me.
This coat of wool cannot keep up with you.

lines.zh: 干草的香味一飘，雪都暖了。
lines.en: One whiff of hay and even the snow feels warm.
I will not snatch it; I will wait.

lines.zh: 你摊开手掌，我鼻尖先到。
lines.en: Open your palm and my nose arrives first.
One bite. Just one bite.
Is there more once this is gone?

lines.zh: 你手上的草味，比雪下的甜。
lines.en: The grass in your hand smells sweeter than snow.

lines.zh: 雪太深，我一步步蹚过来。
lines.en: The snow is deep; I wade over step by step.
Bump me and it is like hitting a pillow.
I am too wide to get through there.

lines.zh: 推一头这样的牛，很费劲。
lines.en: Shoving a cow like me takes real effort.
My wool bounces you right off.
We are only warm when we crowd together.
Make room; I am heading over there.
Brown wool rubs all over your clothes.
I hit the fence and it sways twice.
Do not stand behind my rear end.
Neither of us is giving way.
Two wooly cows stand flank to flank.
I take the wind for it.
We groom each other's wool.
Its horns are shorter than mine.
The calf stands up right after birth.
We press close together in the snow.
It lows, and I low back.
We walk together; nobody gets left behind.

lines.zh: 冬天长，我们有的是时间。
lines.en: Winter is long, and we have the time.

lines.zh: 别看了，我们只是在取暖。
lines.en: Stop watching; we are only keeping warm.
I cannot pick it up; my lips are too thick.
Grass on the ground goes straight into my mouth.
Do not drop wheat; I will flatten it.
This tuft of brown wool is mine.
I lower my head and sniff it.
Take it yourself; I am not going to race you.
Put the shears down first.
My tongue pushes the ice aside.
It rolled right up to my hooves.
I am only interested in things I can eat.
You came with shears, so I am wary.
Someone has made the snow crunch.
I raise my head and there you are.
That smell is not grass.
I edge back into the herd.
The calf is right behind me.
Are you counting us?
I blow a hard breath out of my nose.
Who moved my pile of hay?
I swing my whole bulk around to face you.
My eyes stay fixed on you, unblinking.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我就退一步。
lines.en: You take a step in; I take one back.
My horns are short, but they still hurt.
The herd has closed into a ring.

lines.zh: 那只手再往前，我就不客气了。
lines.en: One more inch with that hand and I stop being nice.
I am breathing faster than before.
That patch of grass under you is mine.
We are not leaving; we are waiting.
Come one step closer and see.
My hoof is pawing at the snow.
I hook my horns under you and shove.
I charge like a wall of wool.
You need three steps to find your balance.
I do not bite; I only charge.
My hooves come down and snow sprays up.

lines.zh: 这身毛撞着不疼，骨头疼。
lines.en: The wool is soft; the bone behind it is not.
I swing my head and tip you over.
Go away and do not come back.
I only meant to frighten you, honestly.

lines.zh: 我喘着，鼻子里全是白气。
lines.en: I pant, my nose full of white steam.
I walk out from behind a snowdrift.
This place is cold enough. I like it.
A herd of brown cows enters the valley.
My wool was thick from the very first day.
Frost settles on my nose.
There is open grass beyond the treeline.
I pack down the first patch of snow.
The wind carries the smell of pine needles.
We spread out, each to its own patch.
This place is one cow short.
My wool catches fire and the smell is sharp.
I roll all the way down the snowy slope.

lines.zh: 冷水浸透了我的毛，很沉。
lines.en: Cold water soaks my wool and drags me down.
The blast shoves me down into the snow.
The arrow sinks into my thick wool.
Violet light wraps around my legs.
The snow is too deep for me to find grass.
Lightning strikes and scorches all my wool.
I fall, and my wool floats after me.
